label: Quality composite (broad)
blurb: Four themes at equal weight: profitability (gross, operating, cash-based, ROE, ROIC), earnings quality (low accruals, percent accruals, net operating assets, M-score), safety (low leverage, stable earnings, O-score, Z-score) and improvement (F-score, margin and turnover trend).
literature: the members of the family, four themes at equal weight
